gbm_population_evidence.quote: Males and females at least 18 years of age on the day of signing informed consent with histopathologic evidence of GBM (from original or recurrent diagnosis) and MRI-confirmed diagnosis of rGBM.

candidate_evidence.quote: to assess the effectiveness of pembrolizumab and lenvatinib combination therapy for recurrent glioblastoma (rGBM) patients wearing TTFields electrodes.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: with radiologically documented disease recurrence after first-line therapy.

role_evidence.quote: participants will be treated with TTFields (200 kHz) + intravenous pembrolizumab 200 mg every three weeks and oral lenvatinib 20 mg once daily until evident progressive disease

agents.drug_class_hint: multikinase (VEGFR/FGFR) inhibitor, approved in thyroid, renal, liver, endometrial cancer

role_evidence.quote: participants will be treated with TTFields (200 kHz) + intravenous pembrolizumab 200 mg every three weeks and oral lenvatinib 20 mg once daily until evident progressive disease

coder_notes: Single-arm Phase 1/2 in recurrent GBM; TTFields is a device partner (not a drug). No molecular biomarker named; archival tissue is required but no marker specified.
